why_seated: MANUS, 27 October 2026, after the twenty-seventh seating entered Deleuze and Guattari as a declared absence: "and a declared absence/ wanted seating: hypatia, d & g, pkd, allen ginsberg, anne carson, and tao lin - including the mandalas. and paul klee. too many files and too many image copyright landmines." Allen Ginsberg (1926–1997) is entered as wanted: the poet of the American line that runs from Whitman (03/01), whom "A Supermarket in California", in Howl and Other Poems, addresses. His books are in copyright: those published before 1978 run ninety-five years from publication, those after it seventy years from his death, to 1 January 2068.
ruling: A declared absence, the wanted seating: the works named, with their rights and opening dates, and no text (MANUS, 2026-10-27).
